Definition: Eliab, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eliab is the name of six Israelites. In Numbers 1:9, the text says "Eliab the son of Helon."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eliab matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
